Diverse perspectives. One shared commitment.

SetuHashi brings together Japanese upbringing, Indian entrepreneurship and global business experience. Our founders share a commitment to connecting businesses and people across India and Japan—and helping those connections become practical business opportunities.

  • Raju Lalwani · Raju

    Managing Partner

    Connects what customers expect with what businesses deliver, drawing on a Japanese upbringing, Indian roots and commercial experience in the United States.

  • Shyam Sundar Pani · Shyam

    Managing Partner

    Shyam connects entrepreneurial experience, business relationships and knowledge of India to help businesses find partners and develop opportunities.

  • Makarand Datar · Mak

    Managing Partner

    Cross-border entrepreneur and business transformation leader, connecting growth strategy, market expansion and execution across more than thirty years.

  • Isha Lagu

    Analyst — Business & Legal

    Combines legal studies with market research and business analysis, supporting opportunity assessments, agreement preparation and project governance.
